app.name: GPU Monitor
monitor.noHosts: No hosts yet. Add a host to start monitoring.
monitor.noGpu: This host has no GPU that GPU Monitor can monitor.
monitor.notConnected: Not connected. Use Connect in the sidebar to connect to this host.
monitor.noProcesses: No processes are using the GPUs.
zoom.outTipMac: Zoom out (⌘ + scroll wheel, or pinch on the trackpad)
zoom.inTipMac: Zoom in (⌘ + scroll wheel, or pinch on the trackpad)
zoom.outTipWin: Zoom out (Ctrl + scroll wheel, or pinch on the touchpad)
zoom.inTipWin: Zoom in (Ctrl + scroll wheel, or pinch on the touchpad)
filter.title: Filter Processes
filter.hint: Text matches any part of the value. Upper and lower case are treated the same. A process is shown when it matches every condition.
gap.title: No data {start} - {end}
form.addressHint: Host name, IP address, or a Host name from ~/.ssh/config.
form.hint: Empty fields use ~/.ssh/config. The password is requested when connecting.
form.portInvalid: Enter a port number from 1 to 65535, or leave it empty.
form.noSpace: The address and the user name cannot contain spaces or @.
prompt.passwordHint: The password is not saved. It is kept in memory only while this host is connected.
prompt.passwordRetry: The password was not accepted. Try again.
prompt.passphraseText: Enter the passphrase for the key {key}.
prompt.passphraseRetry: The passphrase was not accepted. Try again.
upload.uploadText: GPU Monitor needs to upload its remote program to {host}. The upload starts when you click OK.
upload.updateText: The remote program on {host} is older than this GPU Monitor and will be replaced with the new version. The update starts when you click OK.
errors.title: Connection Errors
errorKind.host-key: The host key does not match the entry in ~/.ssh/known_hosts. The connection was refused.
errorKind.platform: This host is not supported. GPU Monitor supports Linux x86_64 hosts only.
errorKind.upload: Cannot upload the remote program to the host.
errorKind.exec: Cannot run the remote program on the host.
errorKind.protocol-too-new: The remote program is newer than this app. Update GPU Monitor on this computer.
errorKind.config: The connection settings or the SSH configuration cannot be used.
errorKind.first-message: The remote program did not start with device information.
errorKind.protocol-mismatch: The remote program reported an unexpected protocol version.
errorCode.not-found: The host or item no longer exists.
errorCode.duplicate: This host is already in the list.
errorCode.user-required: Enter a user name. ~/.ssh/config has none for this host.
errorCode.busy: Disconnect the host before editing or deleting it.
errorCode.active: The recording is being written and cannot be deleted.
delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.text: The host is removed from the list. Its recordings are kept.
recordings.active: Recording in progress. It can be opened but not deleted.
recordings.empty: No recordings yet. A recording is created each time a host is connected.
recordings.deleteText: {size} will be freed. Deleted recordings cannot be restored.
history.title: History
history.pinHint: Click to pin this time, drag to move left or right
history.repinHint: Click to pin this time instead, drag to move left or right
history.noProcesses: No processes were using the GPUs.
settings.appearanceHint: System follows the appearance of the operating system.
settings.curvesHint: Drawn on the monitor and history screens.
quit.title: Quit GPU Monitor?
quit.textOne: 1 host will be disconnected and monitoring will stop.
quit.textMany: {count} hosts will be disconnected and monitoring will stop.
tray.tooltipReconnecting: GPU Monitor - a host is reconnecting
